news.title: Senior Night this Friday: Broncos host the Tigers
news.summary: Come out early to honor our seniors before tip-off. Wear green!
news.body:
Senior Night ceremonies start 20 minutes before tip-off in the Morrison Gym.

Families of seniors, please arrive by 4:30 PM.

news.title: Bus time change for Saturday's away games
news.summary: Buses now leave at 7:15 AM from the front gate.
news.body: Because of road work, buses for Saturday's away games leave 15 minutes earlier, at 7:15 AM from the front gate.

news.title: Broncos fall 51–52 to Knights in a one-point thriller
news.summary: A late Knights bucket decided a game that featured eleven lead changes.
news.body:
The Broncos battled back from an early deficit but came up one point short against Summit Prep.

Full box score and shot chart are on the game page.
